title: Circuit Breaker for a Model Provider
signature: class CircuitBreaker: __init__(self, clock, window_s=60.0, failure_rate=0.5, min_calls=5, open_timeout_s=30.0, half_open_probes=2), state, allow() -> permit or None, record(permit, ok)
hints: Keep a list of (time, ok) outcomes and drop anything at or before now - window_s each time you record. Only trip once at least min_calls outcomes are in the window.
OPEN to HALF_OPEN happens lazily, inside allow(), once open_timeout_s has passed since the trip.
In HALF_OPEN, count the permits you hand out. Probes beyond half_open_probes are rejected even though the breaker isn't open.
Give every state change a new generation number and put it in the permit. A result from an older generation is stale: a slow call admitted before the trip must not close the breaker.
